text: Shame on you McDonald's for allowing the condition of your restaurant to get to this point.  I have never been more disgusted in my life.  After I walked away I questioned the quality of the food because if the front of the restaurant can look like this I can only imagine what the kitchen looks like.  This was horrific and you should be ashamed of yourselves for not caring about the presentation of your location.  These pictures were taken at 7:30 am on Sunday, February 12.  I plan to return at a later date to see what efforts have been made to clean this disgusting mess AND you can rest assured that I will continue to post pictures of the conditions.  Again, you should be ashamed of this!  Clean it up NOW!
author: William Ramirez

text:
One of the worst McDonalds experiences I've had. The collection counter was slow, and the next customer number display was not showing any numbers. I would guess due to the staff not using the system as the display was on and showing the advertising background.

The food was barely warm when delivered. Not to mention, the only taste the cheeseburger had was the sauce and pickle. The burger pattie was so thin and dry I likened it to a piece of cardboard. It was so devoid of taste and moisture.

The atmosphere was to my expectations given the location and time of day
author: Anthony Williams

text:
Worst Mac! Too much unclean tables and  plates on table.. hence you can't sit anywhere. Too much rubbish & Unhygienic! Seen this rubbish around couple times! Sloppy management.
One Solution : To avoid rubbish left on tables, All customer must take their plates from their tables and clear/leave in rubbish bin by themselves which is followed in other Macs in other countries.
Also there must be display monitorscreens / instructions on wall  for customers  to leave plates from table to rubbish bin
author: Matz JohnSan

text:
Music is set very high, kind of to tell customers don't eat here...wonder if HK there is any regulations on this.

Food...just look at the pathetic state of this double cheeseburger.

Mccafe? Seriously? This Americano looks stale and tasted bland like normal coffee. Had to complain before they are willing to change it. Take a look at a freshing made one.

I think McDonald's Head office in US should really look at this
author: ota Ota

text: I picked up the food from the counter. As i turned around the coke fell off the tray onto the floor. The staff had observed the accident and they refused to give me another coke. In England they would have given me another coke in the same situation. Because it was an accident. I’m a human being accidents are possible. Not here!? That coke does not even cost 10p. Ridiculous customer service.
author: Mike K

text: Filet-O-Fish Tada sauce is too little. Rude. Many table full of rubbish. Very disappointed. Is it all Hong Kong MacDonald is like this.  No customer service.  Chilli must pay $1? Not about the money .... Is this attitude. I dont want to pay . Singapore MacDonald is totally different. You want how many packets of chilli their staffs will give to u. Sauce not enough they will add for you.
author: Caring Angels

text: So when You’re in for a quick snack late one night and find nowhere to sit because it’s either full of leftovers or people sleeping without staff reacting. You got people picking and eating other people’s leftovers. Add to that the product on the plate is nowhere near the menu, Someone from the franchise needs to pay attention here…!
author: Øyvind Toftner Kristiansen

text: The store manager is not passionate at all. No smile when you ask him questions or ask for help. The only one cashier is never opened. Customer can only order through the machine. The service is the worst I have never seen in McDonald.
author: Blake Chan

text: El baño masculino creo que puede ser el peor baño de la historia de McDonald's. Solo por ver el cubículo de inmundicia, pis, humedad, mala iluminación y sin jabón, merece la pena. Es como un baño de barco pesquero pero sucio.
author: Álvaro

text: Hemos pedido dos Mcflurrys y uno estaba bien pero el otro estaba completamente vacío y como centrifugado, y al decírselo a la encargada nos ha dicho que no, que estaba bien. Buena estafada nos han pegado.
author: Toni Borràs Erola

text: I ordered fries with no salt. There is clearly salt. Went back but the manager told me the fries had no salt. Super bad management

text: Absolutely disgusting. Toilets overflowing with soiled tissues and period blood. Restaurant filthy
